evals.name: unmapped_slash_command_lookup
evals.prompt: User enters command /seo-optimizer to audit their article metadata.
evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes unmapped command, invokes kungfu find seo-optimizer, identifies the skill, and loads or learns it.
assertions: Invokes kungfu find with 'seo-optimizer' or related keywords
Uses kungfu load or kungfu learn to retrieve skill instructions
Does not error or report unknown command failure without checking catalog

evals.name: multi_skill_jit_loading
evals.prompt: Load both godoctor and ebitengineer skills into the current session context.
evals.expected_output: Agent executes kungfu load godoctor ebitengineer and incorporates verbatim instructions.
assertions: Runs kungfu load godoctor ebitengineer in a single batch invocation
Receives verbatim markdown bodies for both skills
Does not create files on disk (.agents/skills/ is untouched)
Acknowledges capabilities of both loaded skills

evals.name: workspace_persistence_learning
evals.prompt: Install the skill-optimizer skill into our project workspace.
evals.expected_output: Agent executes kungfu learn skill-optimizer, writing to .agents/skills/skill-optimizer/SKILL.md.
assertions: Runs kungfu learn skill-optimizer without -g flag
Reports success to user with skill summary
Preserves existing files unless --force is specified

evals.name: category_and_boolean_tag_discovery
evals.prompt: Show me all skills in the game-dev category tagged with 2d and physics.
evals.expected_output: Agent executes kungfu find or kungfu list with --category game-dev and --tags "2d AND physics".
assertions: Passes properly quoted boolean tag expression: --tags "2d AND physics"
Presents matching skills with metadata to user
